lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਟੇਵ ਏਹ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun gopaal uchaar rasanaa tev eh paree ||1||
lines.translation: My tongue chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World; this has become part of my very nature. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਬੇਧਿ ਤੀਖਨ ਸਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa naad kura(n)k mohio bedh teekhan saree ||
lines.translation: The deer is fascinated by the sound of the bell, and so it is shot with the sharp arrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਠਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: prabh charan kamal rasaal naanak gaath baadh dharee ||2||1||9||
lines.translation: God's Lotus Feet are the Source of Nectar; O Nanak, I am tied to them by a knot. ||2||1||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਸਤ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam basat rid mahi khor ||
lines.translation: My Beloved dwells in the cave of my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bheet nivaar thaakur gahi lehu apanee or ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Shatter the wall of doubt, O my Lord and Master; please grab hold of me, and lift me up towards Yourself. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਗਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਚਾਰਹੁ ਧੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: adhik garat sa(n)saar saagar kar daiaa chaarahu dhor ||
lines.translation: The world-ocean is so vast and deep; please be kind, lift me up and place me on the shore.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਲੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har charan bohith udharate lai mor ||1||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord's Feet are the boat to carry us across. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh ku(n)t mahi jinahi dhaario nahee bikhai ban mahi hor ||
lines.translation: The One who placed you in the womb of your mother's belly - no one else shall save you in the wilderness of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਹੋਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: har sakat saran samarath naanak aan nahee nihor ||2||2||10||
lines.translation: The power of the Lord's Sanctuary is all-powerful; Nanak does not rely on any other. ||2||2||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬਖਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa raam raam bakhaan ||
lines.translation: With your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਏ ਕਲਮਲ ਹਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun goupaal uchaar din rain bhae kalamal haan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, your sins shall be eradicated. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਪਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰ ਪਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiaag chalanaa sagal sa(n)pat kaal sir par jaan ||
lines.translation: You shall have to leave behind all your riches when you depart. Death is hanging over your head - know this well!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mithan moh dura(n)t aasaa jhooth sarapar maan ||1||
lines.translation: Transitory attachments and evil hopes are false. Surely you must believe this! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat purakh akaal moorat ridai dhaarahu dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Within your heart, focus your meditation on the True Primal Being, Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan laabh naanak basat ih paravaan ||2||3||11||
lines.translation: Only this profitable merchandise, the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak, shall be accepted. ||2||3||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam ko aadhaar ||
lines.translation: I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales na kachh biaapai sa(n)tasa(n)g biuhaar || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Suffering and conflict do not afflict me; I deal only with the Society of the Saints. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਤਉ ਬੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar anugrahu aap raakhio nah upajatau bekaar ||
lines.translation: Showering His Mercy on me, the Lord Himself has saved me, and no evil thoughts arise within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis paraapat hoi simarai tis dahat nah sa(n)saar ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever receives this Grace, contemplates Him in meditation; he is not burned by the fire of the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh ma(n)gal aana(n)d har har prabh charan a(n)mrit saar ||
lines.translation: Peace, joy and bliss come from the Lord, Har, Har. God's Feet are sublime and excellent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas saranaagatee tere sa(n)tanaa kee chhaar ||2||4||12||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||2||4||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam bin dhrig srot ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, one's ears are cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਹੋਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop bisaar jeevahi tih kat jeevan hot || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Embodiment of Life - what is the point of their lives? ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਾਰ ਬਾਹਕ ਖੋਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat peet anek bi(n)jan jaise bhaar baahak khot ||
lines.translation: One who eats and drinks countless delicacies is no more than a donkey, a beast of burden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਹਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੋਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar mahaa sram paaiaa jaise birakh ja(n)tee jot ||1||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he endures terrible suffering, like the bull, chained to the oil-press. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਰੋਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj goupaal j aan laage se bahu prakaaree rot ||
lines.translation: Forsaking the Life of the World, and attached to another, they weep and wail in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar jor naanak daan maagai har rakhau ka(n)th parot ||2||5||13||
lines.translation: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this gift; O Lord, please keep me strung around Your Neck. ||2||5||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tah dhoor le mukh malee ||
lines.translation: I take the dust of the feet of the Saints and apply it to my face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਕਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunaa achut sadaa pooran nah dokh biaapahi kalee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Hearing of the Imperishable, Eternally Perfect Lord, pain does not afflict me, even in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਰਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨ ਹਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bachan kaaraj sarab pooran eet oot na halee ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, all affairs are resolved, and the mind is not tossed about here and there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh ek anik sarabat pooran bikhai agan na jalee ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever sees the One God to be pervading in all the many beings, does not burn in the fire of corruption. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahi bhujaa leeno daas apano jot jotee ralee ||
lines.translation: The Lord grasps His slave by the arm, and his light merges into the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: prabh charan saran anaath aaio naanak har sa(n)g chalee ||2||6||14||
lines.translation: Nanak, the orphan, has come seeking the Sanctuary of God's Feet; O Lord, he walks with You. ||2||6||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:
